captions: I am Marn. I keep an account of the supplies here, the lamps they serve, and the people waiting for them. The road light has been unreliable; a neat ledger will not make it answer.
Orro is beside the shrine west of town. Ask him what can be tested, wake that light, and bring me what you actually saw. We can begin with one honest observation.

choices.text: I’ll check the light with Orro

greeting.repeatText: Orro and the roadside shrine are the first check. I will keep the account open until you return.

hint:mission:wammigmig:fair-share.text: Optional: compare Marn’s three readings, balance the local circuit and record an obligation. Return to the main journey when ready.

hint:mission:concordance:road.text: Listen to Orro, wake one light, then confirm its pulse with Marn in Wammigmig. Talk to Orro beside the roadside shrine. Wake the roadside shrine.

captions: The road reading is recorded. Pella has the next question: why does the returning current still fail at our homes?
Ask her about the listening coil. My other accounts can wait; this one begins with someone who has lived with the failing lamps.
story-complete.repeatText: The road light is in the record. Pella can show you what still fails to return.

pending.text: The road reading is not complete yet.

captions: You saw the shrine answer after speaking to Orro. Thank you. I can enter a working road light in the account; I cannot yet promise that the current reaches every home.
Pella keeps the household readings I missed. She says our returning current needs a listening coil. Let us confirm your road reading, then hear her.

local-work.text: We can keep that local task alongside the journey. Which part do you want to discuss?

choices.text: About your other work: A Fair Share of Light
I have your local account: A Fair Share of Light
Fairness must include households and the shared relay.

actions.value: Publish supply, need and shared obligations together.

choices.text: Preserve trade, and make its social costs visible.

actions.value: Keep trade accountable to essential circulation.
